caption:
बॉक्स ऑफिस पर विजय सालगांवकर का दिमाग और Ajay Devgn का जलवा फिर से छा गया है! 🔥

सिनेमाघरों में 24 दिनों के बाद फिल्म Drishyam 3 ने भारत में 369.30 करोड़ का net कलेक्शन कर लिया है। 💥

विदेशों से 142.94 करोड़ जुटाकर फिल्म का worldwide gross collection 578.64 करोड़ तक पहुंच गया है, जो 600 करोड़ के बेंचमार्क के बेहद करीब है। 🚀

कमाल की बात यह है कि Drishyam 3 ने पहली दोनों फिल्मों Drishyam और Drishyam 2 के कुल worldwide gross कलेक्शन (449.53 करोड़) से लगभग 130 करोड़ रुपये ज्यादा कमाए हैं। 🎬

महज 110 करोड़ के बजट में बनी इस थ्रिलर फिल्म की बदौलत पूरी Drishyam franchise का कुल कलेक्शन 1,028.17 करोड़ रुपये का ऐतिहासिक आंकड़ा पार कर चुका है। ✨

क्या आपने सिनेमाघर में Drishyam 3 का यह जबरदस्त सस्पेंस देख लिया है, आपको यह फिल्म कैसी लगी? कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Drishyam 3 Worldwide Box Office: Earns More Than The Combined Total Of Drishyam & Drishyam 2 – Entire Franchise Hits 1000 Crore Globally!
ctx.summary:
Drishyam 3 is inching towards the 600 crore mark globally and has hit two milestones globally - worldwide box office report. 
 The post  Drishyam 3 Worldwide Box Office: Earns More Than The Combined Total Of Drishyam & Drishyam 2 – Entire Franchise Hits 1000 Crore Globally!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Superstar Ajay Devgn and director Abhishek Pathak have officially engraved their names into the absolute records of Indian box office history! The suspense crime thriller Drishyam 3 has completed 24 sensational days in theaters, continuing its triumphant march across both domestic and international markets. The film is moving towards the past 600 crore mark globally!
After 24 days of theatrical glory, Drishyam 3 has amassed a towering domestic net collection of 369.30 crore ( 435.80 crore gross ). Combined with an overseas gross collection of 142.94 crore , the film’s global gross total stands at an extraordinary 578.64 crore ! It is literally 21.36 crore away from hitting the 600 crore mark globally!
With a huge total at the worldwide box office, Ajay Devgn’s threequel has earned more than the combined lifetime worldwide collections of Drishyam ( 109.64 crore ) and Drishyam 2 ( 339.89 crore ). Together, they stand at a total gross collection of 449.53 crore. Meanwhile, the threequel has scored almost 130 crore more than this figure!
With Drishyam 3 moving towards the 600 crore mark, the cumulative worldwide collections of the entire Drishyam franchise have moved past the historic 1,000 crore benchmark! Operating on a tightly controlled production budget of 110 crore, Drishyam 3 has emerged as an absolute goldmine in terms of box office returns.
With all three installments delivering huge theatrical numbers, Vijay Salgaonkar ‘s story stands as one of the massiest crime thriller franchises.
Check out the lifetime collection of all the films of the franchise (Gross Collection Worldwide).
Standing at 578.64 crore worldwide gross, and driving the entire franchise total to a monumental 1,028.17 crore , Drishyam 3 proves that compelling storytelling, sharp intelligence, and stellar star power will always rule at the global box office.
